title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Application of the Provisions of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China on Cultural Relics to Ancient Vertebrate Fossils and Ancient Human Fossils of Scientific Value

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, based on situations encountered in judicial practice, discussed the application of relevant provisions of the Criminal Law to acts of smuggling, stealing, damaging, trafficking, or illegally transferring ancient vertebrate fossils and ancient human fossils of scientific value, and makes the following interpretation:
The provisions of the Criminal Law concerning cultural relics shall apply to ancient vertebrate fossils and ancient human fossils of scientific value.
This is hereby announced.
